name: Schutzhütte Rettenstein
kurzbeschreibung: **Rettenstein Hut** in **Tirol** – a cozy mountain refuge nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, offering breathtaking views of the **Hochfeiler** and **Großvenediger**. Whether you're hiking, climbing, or simply soaking in the alpine atmosphere, this traditional **Hütte** is the perfect retreat. Enjoy hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain air. Open year-round, it’s an ideal base for exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**’s **Ötztal** and **Pitztal** regions.
